scope: Keep the focused .NET producer checkout at depth one while excluding the immutable evidence corpus. Preserve full history for standalone acceptance, and fail closed in both direct proof-erasure and HostNull CI contracts if the sparse checkout is removed.

edits.current:
- name: Check out the focused package revision
        if: ${{ inputs.optional_parameters || inputs.direct_proof_erasure || inputs.host_null }}
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /*
            !/docs/evidence/
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
